テキスト cha 417: Born Shiyo 757, October 15. Height 160cm (as of Shiyo 800). Natsumi Kogori's mother. Her husband is Ryoji Kogori. She works part-time by day and gets through the housework at night. She is one of the people who know Natsumi Kogori's April sickness well, and she now thinks less about curing it than about how to live alongside it.

Her message that she would be late in fact meant that she would be at the police station for a while over the flayed-body case. Her husband Ryoji Kogori was the victim, and she seems to have wanted not to tell her daughter until the victim was confirmed.
She is killed by someone at the Kogori house. She was found with a number of knives driven into her abdomen.
According to Erina Goto, Akane Kogori seems to have committed some wrong, and she was strongly urged to turn herself in. She follows that and gives herself up.

She breaks into the Goto home and dies under gunfire. But why she broke into the Goto home is unclear, and her abnormal leaping and dynamic vision were clearly far beyond human abilities.

According to Erina Goto, she carried out the Megasawa City case together with her husband, Ryoji Kogori. Given her relationship with Mifuyu Niimura, Erina believes she might help with a crime depending on the circumstances.

Just as Erina Goto deduced, she was the one who carried out the Megasawa City case, and she was arrested right after Mifuyu Niimura was caught. However, at this stage the reason she sided with Mifuyu Niimura to that extent is unknown, and mysteries also remain about the spiriting-away-like method.

シナリオ名: A Best Friend and Then Family
テキスト cha 417: Mifuyu Niimura's one and only best friend since early childhood. While accepting Mifuyu Niimura's clingy personality, she spares no advice or support so that Mifuyu can grow as a person.

With Ryoji Kogori she arranged for Mifuyu Niimura and Eiichiro Niimura to meet, but never expected them to promise marriage the day after meeting. Still, she respects Mifuyu's decision and congratulates her. While Mifuyu Niimura spent a year in the Arata settlement, she seems to have been quite lonely, but she was relieved to hear Mifuyu would keep living in Motoki-cho, and around then she became pregnant too.
On learning that Mifuyu Niimura had a stillbirth, she talked it over with Ryoji Kogori and proposed giving her own child to the Niimura family for adoption.
She reunited with Mifuyu Niimura for the first time in two years and was truly glad to see her, but for that very reason Ryoji Kogori worried she might carry out Mifuyu Niimura's plan just as it was.
Judging from her actions so far, she seems to have a habit of opening other people's doors without asking.

After the encounter between Mifuyu Niimura and Natsumi Kogori, she confirms Mifuyu Niimura's true feelings with Ryoji Kogori and holds back from the murder. Since they have come all the way to Megasawa City, she suggests to Ryoji Kogori that they do some sightseeing.

Not told in the main story, but before marriage her hobby was pachinko. Only Mifuyu Niimura knows; she has never told her husband, Ryoji Kogori, about pachinko. She quit when they got engaged, but her gambler's temperament remains, and it seems to have been passed on to her daughter Natsumi too.
Enraged that her plan had been ruined, Mifuyu Niimura tried to attack Natsumi Kogori; Akane tried to stop her, but that only angered Mifuyu Niimura further, and Akane was beheaded with a nata.

She apologizes for leaving Mifuyu Niimura alone without seriously looking for her when she went out of contact for 2 years. Vowing that this time she will never abandon her and will protect her always, she urges her to come back to Motoki-cho together.

シナリオ名: パラサイト・プリズン
テキスト cha 417: Serving life as the one who carried out the Megasawa City case, she tries to flee to Arata with Natsumi Kogori amid the Great Motoki Earthquake. Seeing Haruka Niimura as a divine messenger, and Natsumi dead and reborn as one, she says "I'm tired now" and gives up. Urged by her daughters, she too becomes one, living on forever in the giant cherry.\nYet she says the Megasawa City case was someone else's doing.

シナリオ名: メガミゴロシミナゴロシ
テキスト cha 417: In the Shiyo 800 incident in Motoki-cho, she takes Droga from Mifuyu Niimura and breaks into the Goto home, but is shot by the police and dies. She broke into the Goto home because she had realized Motoki-cho was no longer safe, and meant to take Natsumi Kogori and Haruka Niimura and escape it.
